app.title: LightPen
app.tagline: Write on PDFs in the air

viewer.dropHint: Drop a PDF here, or use Open PDF
viewer.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected and cannot be opened.
viewer.corrupt: This file could not be read as a PDF. It may be corrupt.
viewer.tooLarge: This PDF is too large to open (max 200 MB).

camera.privacy: All video processing happens on this device. No frames ever leave your device.
camera.rationaleBody: LightPen uses your camera to track your hand so you can write in the air. Nothing is recorded or uploaded. The camera is only on while tracking is active.
camera.denied: Camera permission was denied. You can still draw with your mouse or finger.
camera.notFound: No camera was found. Check that one is connected.
camera.inUse: The camera is in use by another app. Close it and try again.
camera.unsupported: Camera is not supported here. You can still draw manually.
camera.hintTooFar: Your hand looks far away — move closer.
camera.hintTooClose: Your hand looks too close — move back a little.
camera.hintLowLight: Low light detected — try a brighter spot.
camera.hintOutOfFrame: Hand out of frame — move it into view.
camera.modelMissing: Hand-tracking model not found. Run `npm run fetch:model` or reinstall the app.

gestures.hover: Point with index finger to move the cursor
gestures.swipe: Swipe sideways with open palm for next/previous page
gestures.pause: Hold a fist for 1 second to pause tracking
gestures.pauseArt: A closed fist, an arrow to a clock, and a pause symbol: holding a fist for one second pauses tracking.

tutorial.title: Welcome to LightPen
tutorial.welcome: Write on PDFs in the air with your hand. Everything runs on your device.
tutorial.privacy: Your camera video never leaves this device. No recording, no uploads, no tracking.
tutorial.permission: First, allow camera access so LightPen can see your hand.
tutorial.placement: Place your camera at eye level, about an arm's length away, in good light. Keep your hand inside the frame.
tutorial.placementDistance: About one arm's length from the camera.
tutorial.placementArt: Two camera setups: a camera level with your eyes, and a camera below your raised hand, which is harder to track.
tutorial.placementDistanceArt: A camera on the left, a dashed line to a person on the right, showing an arm's length of distance.
tutorial.calibration: Drag a box over the area where you will move your hand — that box becomes the page.
tutorial.calibrationHint: Comfort is more important than size: pick a box you can reach without stretching. You can redo this later from the tutorial.
tutorial.exHover: Point your index finger at the page (hover).
tutorial.exWrite: Pinch thumb and index together to draw a line.
tutorial.exErase: Show an open palm over your line to erase it.
tutorial.exSwipe: Swipe sideways with an open palm.
tutorial.exPause: Hold a fist for one second.
tutorial.done: Great! You know all the gestures. Here is your cheat sheet.
